overloads.semanticRole: The SMTP New transporter command configures a new SMTP connection according to the server parameter and returns a new SMTP transporter object object.

constraints: The parameter object's .host property is mandatory; all other properties are optional and default as documented (e.g. .port defaults to 587, .connectionTimeOut to 30s, .sendTimeOut to 100s, .keepAlive to True, .acceptUnsecureConnection to False).

If .accessTokenOAuth2 is passed but .authenticationMode is omitted, the OAuth2 protocol is used (if allowed by the server); .authenticationMode otherwise defaults to the most secure mode supported by the server.
.accessTokenOAuth2 and .password are consumed for authentication but are not echoed back on the returned SMTP transporter object.

This command only configures the transporter; it does not open a connection to the SMTP server. The connection is actually opened when .send() is called, and is closed either when the transporter object is destroyed (if .keepAlive is true) or after each .send() call (if .keepAlive is false).
